output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is 21000000 * 10^8, which is a large number, and the mintedAmount is added to balanceOf[target] without any overflow check, causing a potential exploitable issue.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[msg.sender] is less than _value, allowing it to overflow and set balanceOf[msg.sender] to a negative value, causing a potential exploitable issue.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_from] is less than _value, allowing it to overflow and set balanceOf[_from] to a negative value, causing a potential exploitable issue.

The buy function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function calculates the amount of tokens to sell based on the exchange rate (buyPrice), but it does not check if the contract has enough tokens to sell. If the buyPrice is set to a very high value, attackers can exploit this function to buy up all the tokens in the contract, rendering it unusable.

The sell function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function allows users to sell tokens at a fixed rate (sellPrice), but it does not check if the user has enough tokens to sell, allowing attackers to set the sellPrice to a very low value, causing attackers to lose funds.
